description: This file contains service functions for interacting with OpenAI tools within a Flowise-based application, including building and initializing tools, retrieving agent tools, and executing agent tools with handling of source documents, artifacts, and tool arguments.

methods.name: buildAndInitTool
methods.description: Builds and initializes a tool agent for a given chatflow, setting up the graph, nodes, and dependencies, and returning the agent instance.

methods.name: getAgentTools
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tools available for a specific chatflow agent, converting them to OpenAI function format.

methods.name: executeAgentTool
methods.description: Executes a specified tool within a chatflow agent, processes the output, and extracts source documents, artifacts, and tool arguments.
